en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a historic building with classical architecture, a triangular pediment, and a tiled roof. The building is adorned with a flag featuring a Nordic cross, indicating Scandinavian origin. The text at the bottom identifies the building as 'Kalmar. Rådhuset.' There are a few people and vintage cars visible, and adjacent buildings are also partially shown.
